meta.execution: Signal at T close, execution at T+1 open; final close forced at interval end.

current_app.formula: Entry: AMD close breaks prior 66d high/low. Filters: AMD close above/below SMA80; AMD ROC60 > 8%; QQQ SMA50 filter; QQQ ROC120 > 4%; AMD-QQQ ROC80 > 6%. Exit: 43d opposite channel; fixed stop 24%; trailing stop 10%; take profit 20%.

top3.formula: Entry: AMD close breaks prior 20d high/low. Filters: AMD close above/below SMA200; AMD ROC60 > 4%; QQQ ROC120 > 0%; AMD-QQQ ROC60 > 6%; ATR20% <= 6.0%. Exit: EMA200; 16d opposite channel; fixed stop 10%; trailing stop 12%.

Entry: AMD SMA46 crosses SMA131; short side symmetric. Filters: AMD close above/below SMA200; AMD close above/below EMA200; AMD ROC20 > -10%. Exit: raw reverse MA cross; fixed stop 20%; take profit 50%; ATR stop 3.5x; max hold 93d.
Entry: AMD close crosses EMA80. Filters: AMD close above/below SMA100. Exit: qualified reverse signal; take profit 16%; max hold 37d.
